name: PerfMon
tagline: Windows 11 Task Manager & Precision Telemetry Suite
short_description: A native macOS system monitor with cross-app Low Effort Suite theme and persistent Dock icon sync, per-process and socket network download/upload speeds, selectable desktop widget previews, eight graph styles, USB/TB power telemetry, and a custom menu bar builder.
spotlight_description: PerfMon 2.0 unifies the Low Effort Suite with cross-app theme, accent, and persistent Dock icon synchronization across PerfMon, EventMon, VolMon, and WebMon, plus native desktop widget level and magnetic snap-to-grid, per-process and per-socket download/upload speeds, and cumulative network bytes across the Process and Network grids.
